chapterInfo.content:
25
Fakyɛ ne kwankyerɛ ho mpaebɔ
Dawid deɛ.
1AWURADE, wo na mema me kra so mekyerɛ woɔ.
2Me Nyankopɔn, wo so na mede me ho matoɔ,
mma m’ani nnwu,
mma m’atamfoɔ ho nnsɛpɛ wɔn, me nti.
3 # Yes 49.23 Ampa ara, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wo kwan no biara ani renwu,
wɔn a wɔtwa nkontompo kwa no na wɔn ani bɛwuo.
4 # Dwom 27.11 AWURADE, kyerɛ me w’akwan,
na fa me fa w’atempɔn so.
5Ma mennante wo nokorɛ mu, na kyerɛkyerɛ me,
ɛfiri sɛ wone me nkwagyeɛ Nyankopɔn,
m’ani da wo so daa nyinaa.
6AWURADE, kae wo mmɔborɔhunu ne w’adɔeɛ
a ɛwɔ hɔ firi tete no.
7 # Hiob 13.26 Nkae me mmɔfraase bɔne ne me mfomsoɔ, na mmom
kae me sɛdeɛ w’adɔeɛ teɛ,
AWURADE, w’ayamyie nti.
8AWURADE yɛ, na ɔtene,
enti na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ ɔkwan soɔ.
9Ɔma ahobrɛasefoɔ nante tenenee mu,
na ɔma ahobrɛasefoɔ sua ne kwan.
10AWURADE atempɔn nyinaa yɛ adɔeɛ ne nokorɛ
ma wɔn a wɔdi n’apam ne n’adansesɛm soɔ.
11AWURADE, wo din nti fa me bɔne kyɛ me,
na ɛdɔɔso pii.
12 # Dwom 32.8 Onipa biara a ɔsuro AWURADE no,
ɔbɛkyerɛ no kwan a ɔmfa soɔ.
13 # Dwom 37.9 Ne kra bɛtena yiedie mu,
na n’asefoɔ anya asase atena so.
14 # Hiob 29.4 AWURADE yi ne tirim asɛm kyerɛ wɔn a wɔsuro no,
na ɔma wɔhunu n’apam no mu.
15M’ani hwɛ AWURADE daa,
na ɔno na ɔbɛyi me nan afiri afidie mu.
16Dane w’ani hwɛ me, na dom me,
na meyɛ ankonam, na meyɛ mmɔbɔ.
17M’akoma mu ahohia so,
yi me firi m’ahokyere mu.
18Hwɛ m’amaneɛ ne m’ahometeɛ,
na fa me bɔne nyinaa kyɛ me.
19 # Dwom 35.19 Hwɛ sɛ m’atamfoɔ dɔɔso,
na wɔde atirimuɔden tane me.
20 # Dwom 16.1 Hwɛ me kra so na gye me,
mma m’ani nnwu, na medwane bɛtoa wo.
21 # Hiob 1.1 Ma pɛyɛ ne teeyɛ nhwɛ me so,
ɛfiri sɛ m’ani da wo so.
22 # Dwom 130.8 Onyankopɔn, gye Israel
firi wɔn ahohia nyinaa mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
AWURADE, wo na mema me kra so mekyerɛ woɔ.
Me Nyankopɔn, wo so na mede me ho matoɔ,
mma m’ani nnwu,
mma m’atamfoɔ ho nnsɛpɛ wɔn, me nti.
Ampa ara, wɔn a wɔhwɛ wo kwan no biara ani renwu,
wɔn a wɔtwa nkontompo kwa no na wɔn ani bɛwuo.
AWURADE, kyerɛ me w’akwan,
na fa me fa w’atempɔn so.
Ma mennante wo nokorɛ mu, na kyerɛkyerɛ me,
ɛfiri sɛ wone me nkwagyeɛ Nyankopɔn,
m’ani da wo so daa nyinaa.
AWURADE, kae wo mmɔborɔhunu ne w’adɔeɛ
a ɛwɔ hɔ firi tete no.
Nkae me mmɔfraase bɔne ne me mfomsoɔ, na mmom
kae me sɛdeɛ w’adɔeɛ teɛ,
AWURADE, w’ayamyie nti.
AWURADE yɛ, na ɔtene,
enti na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ nnebɔneyɛfoɔ ɔkwan soɔ.
Ɔma ahobrɛasefoɔ nante tenenee mu,
na ɔma ahobrɛasefoɔ sua ne kwan.
AWURADE atempɔn nyinaa yɛ adɔeɛ ne nokorɛ
ma wɔn a wɔdi n’apam ne n’adansesɛm soɔ.
AWURADE, wo din nti fa me bɔne kyɛ me,
na ɛdɔɔso pii.
Onipa biara a ɔsuro AWURADE no,
ɔbɛkyerɛ no kwan a ɔmfa soɔ.
Ne kra bɛtena yiedie mu,
na n’asefoɔ anya asase atena so.
AWURADE yi ne tirim asɛm kyerɛ wɔn a wɔsuro no,
na ɔma wɔhunu n’apam no mu.
M’ani hwɛ AWURADE daa,
na ɔno na ɔbɛyi me nan afiri afidie mu.
Dane w’ani hwɛ me, na dom me,
na meyɛ ankonam, na meyɛ mmɔbɔ.
M’akoma mu ahohia so,
yi me firi m’ahokyere mu.
Hwɛ m’amaneɛ ne m’ahometeɛ,
na fa me bɔne nyinaa kyɛ me.
Hwɛ sɛ m’atamfoɔ dɔɔso,
na wɔde atirimuɔden tane me.
Hwɛ me kra so na gye me,
mma m’ani nnwu, na medwane bɛtoa wo.
Ma pɛyɛ ne teeyɛ nhwɛ me so,
ɛfiri sɛ m’ani da wo so.
Onyankopɔn, gye Israel
firi wɔn ahohia nyinaa mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
